label: Gemini 4 Argon
definition: A capability is certified when, over the last three weeks of nightly runs, its tests pass at least 85 percent of the time with 95 percent confidence, and no single test falls below 80 percent. A regression shows within two nights. The exact rule: evaluated on the published tests for that capability, on a named model; the newest 60 graded runs per test; a 95 percent Wilson lower bound of at least 0.85 on the row (57 of 60 for a single test); no single test below 80 percent; the record published. Certified lapses when the lower bound sits below 0.70 on two nightly checks in a row.
guarantee: The agent can only propose a change, never apply one: read-only access rights and a gateway that blocks writes.
